FAQ

Is the Open House free?

Yes. Registration and attendance are free.

Do I need to register?

Registration is recommended so our team can plan for attendance and prepare for your visit.

Is my selected time a private appointment?

No. This is an Open House. The selected time simply tells us approximately when you plan to arrive.

Can international students attend?

Yes.

Can PGWP holders attend?

Yes.

Can work permit holders attend?

Yes.

Can visitors attend?

Yes.

Will I receive individual immigration advice?

The Open House provides information about potential immigration pathways and an opportunity to discuss your circumstances. Detailed individual advice may require a separate consultation.

Does attending guarantee PR eligibility?

No. Eligibility and immigration outcomes depend on individual circumstances and applicable Canadian immigration requirements.
